title: Review large number ungrouped
why: Long decimal literals are hard to verify visually and easy to mistype.
suggestion: Group decimal digits with the language's separator syntax so scale and transpositions are easier to review.
limitations: Strings, comments, C++ apostrophe-grouped decimals, prefixed hexadecimal and binary literals, dense protocol enum value catalogs, and Shell sources without portable decimal digit-grouping syntax are excluded.

Digits embedded in identifiers are not numeric literals. Rust ordinary multiline, raw, byte, and character literals use the shared Rust lexer; genuine decimal tokens with supported suffixes remain eligible.
